hypothesis: Add only CMA-ES-LED signal-to-noise effective-dimensionality adaptation to the Parent's covariance update: estimate which current covariance eigen-directions carry persistent mean or rank-mu update signal, sum their soft effectiveness weights, and calculate the covariance-path, rank-one, and rank-mu learning rates from that estimated effective dimension instead of the nominal 32-dimensional latent width.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic MolMIM-style probabilistic SMILES autoencoder only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, using variance-conditioned latent training so local perturbations remain decodable, and then freeze it. In each independent objective session, encode the fixed evaluated starting molecules, center a CMA-ES search distribution on the best observed latent, and repeat an ask/tell loop: sample a fresh latent population from the current multivariate Gaussian, decode each point de novo, canonicalize and locally replace invalid or previously seen molecules, submit only the newly decoded batch, and update the Gaussian mean, covariance, and global step size from the returned score ranks. The method neither fits a surrogate nor screens the corpus; oracle feedback changes the continuous proposal distribution directly, so coordinated latent directions that repeatedly yield better molecules receive more probability during the 290 adaptive calls. The sole success target is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

applicability_conditions: Oracle reward must vary primarily along fewer persistent coordinated directions than the 32-dimensional frozen latent representation exposes.
Accepted batches must retain non-tied finite scores so score-rank mean and rank-mu update directions provide a usable signal-to-noise contrast.
The evolving covariance eigenbasis must become stable enough across the 29 feedback rounds for direction-wise signal accumulation to distinguish persistent signal from sampling noise.

The mechanism is less likely to transfer when nearly all latent directions are reward-relevant, when rank signals change direction faster than the accumulators can track, or when useful reward regions are disconnected and unreachable by the Parent's one-Gaussian decoder-supported proposal distribution.
The frozen decoder must continue to fill every announced batch under the unchanged bounded invalid, evaluated, prior-emission, and within-round duplicate rejection path.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified in this setting if the non-tied feedback updates do not produce finite direction-wise SNR and effectiveness state, if the estimated effective dimension never falls below the nominal 32-dimensional reference enough to change a covariance learning rate, or if a subsequent covariance update does not consume rates reproducibly calculated from the preceding retained estimate. Any of these observations would show that effective-dimension adaptation did not redirect covariance learning away from the Parent's nominal-dimension behavior.
research_intent.implementation_change: Preserve the prepared autoencoder, frozen de novo decoder, best-initial latent center, Gaussian ask path, positive score-rank recombination weights, canonical novelty filters, feedback matching, and the Parent's cumulative step-size path and damping rule. Add task-local zero-initialized signal and second-moment accumulators for the normalized mean-update and diagonal rank-mu-update directions in the contemporaneous covariance eigenbasis. After each finite non-tied tell, update those accumulators with the fixed CMA-ES-LED smoothing rule, transform the larger per-direction SNR through its dimension- and population-dependent soft effectiveness mapping, and retain the clipped sum as the effective dimension for the next tell. Substitute only that retained effective dimension into the existing covariance-path, rank-one, and rank-mu rate formulas; keep their bounded positive-definite covariance update and log the nominal and adapted rates, per-direction SNRs and effectiveness weights, and the generation in which each estimate is consumed.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-f51438619a6b completed all 29 feedback rounds on every seed-0 task and activated score-rank mean, covariance, and step-size updates on all 145 tells, but its covariance adaptation treats all 32 latent coordinates as equally relevant when setting the learning rates. The resulting covariance movement remained finite but modest while terminal Top-1 reached only 0.204834 on median_2 and 0.196894 on sitagliptin_mpo, so the Parent has no way to concentrate its limited covariance-learning opportunity on the subset of evolving eigen-directions that carry repeatable reward signal.

The unchanged frozen-decoder novelty path remained viable across all Search Seeds: all 435 suggestion rounds filled the announced batch of 10, emitting 4,350 task-locally novel valid canonical molecules from 39,559 fresh latent draws. The hardest round used 706 of the bounded 2,048 draws, and all 15 task runs completed 300 oracle calls with zero evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempts.

The activation result now covers seeds 0, 1, and 2 for this formal batch-10 profile, but direct Algorithmic-Parent telemetry is available only on seed 0. The evidence does not establish transfer when accepted scores are tied or nonfinite, rank directions turn over faster than smoothing can retain signal, most latent directions are reward-relevant, the covariance eigenbasis is too unstable for persistent coordinate-wise evidence, or useful chemistry lies outside the inherited one-Gaussian frozen-decoder support.
